A few questions, answered.

All parent questions →
Does submitting an enquiry reserve a seat?

No. An enquiry is a request for information. Availability, eligibility, documents and admission confirmation must be discussed with the school.

What are the fees?

Ask the office for a current, written quote for the class you are considering, including any admission, books, uniform and transport charges. The budget planner uses only amounts you enter and is not a school fee quote.

Is transport available for our area?

Please confirm your area, pick-up point, timings, charges and current route availability with the office before making plans. A route is not guaranteed by this website.

Can we visit before deciding?

Contact the office to request a campus visit. Wait for the school to confirm a suitable day and time before travelling.
